title: Proposal image editing: flood fill and luma Gaussian pipeline
description: Out-of-catalog proposal shard over generated straight-alpha RGBA bytes. It defines exact controlled JavaScript and fixed-memory scalar Wasm results but supplies no browser timing evidence or catalog-v1 coverage.

inputs.generation: Integer-only repository generator with fixed seeds emits raw row-major straight-alpha RGBA8 fixtures; generated bytes are dedicated under CC0-1.0.

oracle.policy: Flood fill requires exact output RGBA and visited-mask hashes, changed count, bounds, and work counters. The luma plus separable 3-tap Gaussian pipeline requires exact output RGBA and counters. Small adversarial cases compare every byte.
oracle.floatingPointPolicy: No floating-point operations occur in either controlled algorithm. All arithmetic, thresholds, coefficients, borders, shifts, and rounding are unsigned integer operations defined in measurement-contract.json.
oracle.deadCodeDefense: Correctness reads and hashes every output byte and the complete flood visited mask outside the resident algorithm phase. Timing is not authorized by this proposal shard.

work.complexity: Flood fill is O(visited pixels); the luma Gaussian pipeline is three fixed O(width*height) passes.
work.tolerance: Controlled output bytes, masks, dimensions, algorithm counters, copied bytes, and crossings match exactly. Target-owned materialization allocation counts remain separately reported because Wasm owns one pre-instantiated linear memory.

missingCells.reason: No optimized algorithm is proposed in this shard.

missingCells.cell: Canvas upload and presentation proxy timings
missingCells.reason: The phase contract is declared, but no authoritative browser performance run is authorized.
The frozen 38-row catalog is unchanged; this proposal cannot claim coverage.
